about: The agent comment tools' rules (M70.3), replayed by src-tauri/src/comment_tools.rs (replays_the_shared_quote_filter, replays_the_shared_comment_tool_cases) and by src/lib/mockIpc.test.ts, so the packaged app and the browser mock find, refuse and post alike. `quotes`: the markdown a comment quote may not hold, named as its refusal names it (null: none). `matches`: where a quote reads as text on the page, as quote.rs's comment_matches and quote.ts's commentMatches keep the one finder's matches: the 1-based body line of each, in order, and the context its anchor stores (`before` and `after`, from its own line, cut at markdown and at 40 code points). `calls`: one tool call on `page`, whose file holds `bytes`, with its sidecar absent (none), holding `sidecar` (seeded) or holding these raw bytes; the answer `text` and whether it is an error, `{id}` standing for the new thread's id. A refused call changes no byte of the page or its sidecar. `posted` is the thread the call wrote: its anchor, how many comments it holds, whether it is resolved and its last comment's body; a comment the call posted is the run's actor's (claude-code), with its run id. The page's bytes never change. The per-run cap is Rust's alone, so it has no case here.
